description: This file contains utility functions for network interface management, process handling, and system command execution, primarily used in embedded or network device software. It includes functions for setting interface parameters, retrieving hardware and IP addresses, process identification, and service control, with conditional support for Wi-Fi management features.

methods.name: vsystem
methods.description: Executes a formatted system command, logs the command, and returns the system call result.

methods.name: sysctl_iface_set
methods.description: Writes content to a specified sysctl interface file, optionally formatted with interface name.

methods.name: iface_get_hwaddr
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a specified network interface.

methods.name: iface_get_ipv4addr
methods.description: Gets the IPv4 address assigned to a specified network interface.

methods.name: is_iface_present
methods.description: Checks if a network interface exists and is reachable.

methods.name: pid_of
methods.description: Finds the process ID of a process by name and optional keyword.

methods.name: serv_can_start
methods.description: Determines if a service can be started based on its current status.

methods.name: serv_can_stop
methods.description: Determines if a service can be stopped based on its current status.

methods.name: psmGet
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from the PSM database (Wi-Fi management support).

methods.name: updateDhcpPoolData
methods.description: Updates DHCP pool configuration data from PSM parameters into a file (Wi-Fi management support).
